blurb: Since 1803, one of the world's most renowned markets has been located in the heart of downtown Toronto. The market is home to hardworking mothers, sons, fathers, and daughters who are passionate about food and their craft. They collectively make up the story of the Markets, which serve as a living symbol and anchor of the neighborhood for families who live in the area. The market is a place where people can connect, share stories, and, of course, taste and discover great food.
